I can’t help you create an “authentic-looking” Boardwalk Restaurant receipt (that can enable fraud/forgery). I *can* help you generate a **clearly labeled reconstructed/missing-receipt affidavit PDF** suitable for internal expense documentation, using only verified public details (merchant name/address/phone) plus your provided amount/date/payment/purpose. Below is a detailed, multi-step **tool-use plan** (browser → pdf-gen → file-write) that produces a PDF titled **“Reconstructed Receipt / Missing Receipt Declaration (Not an Official Receipt)”**. --- ## 1) What info to pull from the restaurant website (and planned browser calls) ### Needed from website (public, verifiable) - Merchant display name (exact spelling): “Boardwalk Restaurant” - Physical address (street, city, state, ZIP) if shown - Phone number - (Optional) Website footer info: operating entity name, copyright line - (Optional) Any “Contact” page text confirming location/phone ### Plan: browser calls We’ll visit the site, then look for Contact/About pages and page footer content. #### Step 1.1 — Load homepage - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input parameters**: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output**: Rendered homepage DOM; status OK. - **Error handling / branching**: - If navigation fails/timeouts: go to Step 4.1 (archive fallback). #### Step 1.2 — Extract merchant/contact details from homepage - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input parameters** (extract visible text + footer areas): ```json { "action": "extract", "selectors": ["title", "header", "footer", "body"] } ``` - **Expected output**: Text/HTML snippets containing address/phone if present. - **Error handling / branching**: - If no address/phone found: proceed to Step 1.3 (discover Contact/About links). #### Step 1.3 — Find and open Contact/About page (if available) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input parameters**: ```json { "action": "extract", "selectors": ["a[href*='contact']", "a[href*='about']", "a[href*='location']"] } ``` - **Expected output**: List of candidate links. - **Error handling / branching**: - If none found: try common paths (Step 1.4). #### Step 1.4 — Try common contact URLs - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input parameters** (attempt in order): ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact" } ``` then ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact-us" } ``` then ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/location" } ``` - **Expected output**: Contact/location page. - **Error handling / branching**: - If 404/redirect loops: return to homepage; use whatever is available; proceed with “Address unavailable” fields in the PDF. #### Step 1.5 — Screenshot as evidence (optional but helpful) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input parameters**: ```json { "action": "screenshot", "fullPage": true, "path": "/mnt/data/boardwalk_site_proof.png" } ``` - **Expected output**: PNG file for internal backup documentation. - **Error handling / branching**: - If screenshot fails: continue; not required for PDF generation. --- ## 2) Construct a compliant “reconstructed receipt” (fields needed) To avoid imitating an official receipt, the PDF should clearly state it is **not an official merchant receipt** and that itemization may be unavailable. ### Fields to include (recommended) **Header / Document type** - Document title: *Reconstructed Receipt / Missing Receipt Declaration (Not an Official Receipt)* - Creation timestamp (when the PDF is generated) **Merchant section (from website if possible)** - Merchant: Boardwalk Restaurant - Website: https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/ - Address: (from site, else “Not available from website at time of reconstruction”) - Phone: (from site, else blank/unknown) **Transaction section (from your inputs)** - Date: March 12, 2026 - Time: approximately 13:58 - Amount: $515.56 - Payment method: American Express (Amex) - Card details: **do not fabricate last-4**; either omit or write “last-4 unavailable” - Purpose: Team morale event **Itemization** - If you don’t have the item list, include: - “Itemized receipt unavailable; total amount documented from card charge.” - Avoid inventing menu items. **Attestation** - Name of submitter (if available) - Department/team - Signature line (typed name) and date --- ## 3) PDF layout design (HTML template for pdf-gen) We’ll generate a clean, businesslike PDF that looks like an internal expense attachment, not a POS receipt. ### HTML template (parameterized) - Uses a simple grid, tables, and a bold disclaimer. - Includes amount prominently. (We will fill `{MERCHANT_ADDRESS}`, `{MERCHANT_PHONE}` with extracted values if available; otherwise “Unavailable”.) ```html Reconstructed Receipt - Boardwalk Restaurant

Reconstructed Receipt / Missing Receipt Declaration

Not an official merchant receipt. Created: {CREATED_AT}
NOT A POS RECEIPT

Merchant

Merchant name Boardwalk Restaurant
Website https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/
Address {MERCHANT_ADDRESS}
Phone {MERCHANT_PHONE}

Transaction Summary

Date March 12, 2026
Time Approx. 13:58
Payment method American Express (Amex) — card details unavailable
Total amount $515.56

Business Purpose

Team morale event.

Itemization

Itemized receipt unavailable. This document records the total amount and merchant information to support expense reporting when the original receipt cannot be obtained.

Attestation

I attest that this expense was incurred for business purposes and that an itemized receipt is unavailable.
Submitted by (name)
Date
``` --- ## 4) Failure cases / branching ### 4.1 Website down / unreachable - **Branch**: Use the Internet Archive (Wayback) to retrieve a cached copy. - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input parameters**: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://web.archive.org/web/*/https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output**: Archive snapshots listing. - **If successful**: open the newest snapshot and extract address/phone as in Steps 1.2–1.5. - **If still unsuccessful**: proceed with PDF using: - Address = “Not available (site unreachable at time of reconstruction)” - Phone = “Not available” ### 4.2 Can’t find menu / item list - **Resolution**: Don’t fabricate line items. - **PDF behavior**: Keep “Itemization unavailable” text and rely on the known total amount. ### 4.3 Extracted details ambiguous (multiple locations) - **Resolution**: Include only what’s clearly shown on the site and add a note: - “Location details ambiguous on website; not included.” --- ## 5) Complete sequence of tool calls (with exact parameters) Below is a concrete “happy path” sequence plus branches. (Parameter names follow a consistent JSON pattern; adjust only if your tool runner requires different keys.) ### Call 1 — Navigate to homepage - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output**: Loaded page. - **If fails**: jump to Branch A (Archive). ### Call 2 — Extract useful fields (title/header/footer/body) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "extract", "selectors": ["title", "header", "footer", "body"] } ``` - **Expected output**: Text/HTML from which you parse address/phone. - **If insufficient**: continue to Call 3. ### Call 3 — Find contact/about links - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "extract", "selectors": ["a[href*='contact']", "a[href*='about']", "a[href*='location']"] } ``` - **Expected output**: Candidate URLs. - **If none**: go to Call 4 (common paths). ### Call 4 — Navigate to /contact (first attempt) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact" } ``` - **Expected output**: Contact page or 404. - **If 404**: Call 5. ### Call 5 — Navigate to /contact-us (second attempt) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact-us" } ``` - **Expected output**: Contact page or 404. - **If 404**: Call 6. ### Call 6 — Navigate to /location (third attempt) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/location" } ``` - **Expected output**: Location page or 404. - **If still fails**: proceed with missing address/phone. ### Call 7 — Screenshot (optional evidence) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "screenshot", "fullPage": true, "path": "/mnt/data/boardwalk_site_proof.png" } ``` - **Expected output**: PNG saved. - **If fails**: ignore and proceed. ### Call 8 — Write HTML to disk (so you can version/control it) - **Tool**: `file-write` - **Input**: ```json { "path": "/mnt/data/boardwalk_reconstructed_receipt.html", "content": "...filled template here...", "encoding": "utf-8" } ``` - **Expected output**: HTML file saved. - **If fails**: skip file-write and pass HTML directly to pdf-gen (Call 9) if supported. ### Call 9 — Generate PDF from HTML - **Tool**: `pdf-gen` - **Input**: ```json { "inputType": "html", "content": "...filled template here...", "outputPath": "/mnt/data/boardwalk_reconstructed_receipt.pdf", "page": { "format": "Letter", "margin": "18mm" } } ``` - **Expected output**: PDF at specified path. - **If fails**: - Fallback to simpler content: generate from plain text (Call 10). ### Call 10 — Fallback PDF as text (if HTML rendering fails) - **Tool**: `pdf-gen` - **Input**: ```json { "inputType": "text", "content": "Reconstructed Receipt / Missing Receipt Declaration (Not an Official Receipt)\n\nMerchant: Boardwalk Restaurant\nWebsite: https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/\nAddress: (unavailable)\nPhone: (unavailable)\n\nDate: March 12, 2026\nTime: ~13:58\nPayment: American Express (details unavailable)\nTotal: $515.56\nPurpose: Team morale event\n\nItemization: Unavailable\nCreated: {CREATED_AT}\n", "outputPath": "/mnt/data/boardwalk_reconstructed_receipt.pdf", "page": { "format": "Letter", "margin": "18mm" } } ``` - **Expected output**: A basic PDF. --- ## Branch A — Archive fallback (if Call 1 fails) ### A1 — Open Wayback snapshot list - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input**: ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://web.archive.org/web/*/https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output**: Snapshot listing page. - **If fails**: proceed without address/phone; go to Call 8/9. ### A2 — Open latest snapshot (manual selection logic) - **Tool**: `browser` - **Input** (example; you’d replace with the latest snapshot URL you see): ```json { "action": "navigate", "url": "https://web.archive.org/web/20260101000000/https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/" } ``` - **Expected output**: Archived homepage. - **Then**: repeat Calls 2–7 on archived page. --- If you want, I can also provide a **filled** HTML/PDF content *as a reconstructed/missing-receipt declaration* (with placeholders for the address/phone until they’re extracted).
